William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

On Friends and Foes

Mr. Stothard to Mr. Cromek: For Fortune’s favours you your riches bring

XVIII
F
OR
 Fortune’s favours you your riches bring,
But Fortune says she gave you no such thing.
Why should you be ungrateful to your friends,—
Sneaking and backbiting, and odds and ends?
